title: Remote Hosts Config
description: Configuration for SSH-accessible remote inference hosts used by a remote-ssh dispatch target.

$schema.description: Optional self-reference to the schema file.

ssh_key_path.description: Path to SSH private key. Resolved relative to operator home dir if not absolute.

platform.description: Target platform for shell command adaptation.

shell.description: Default shell to use for remote command execution.

inference_engine.description: Inference engine available on the remote host.

ollama_base_url.description: Ollama API base URL when inference_engine is ollama.

default_model.description: Default model tag to use when none is specified in the dispatch.

available_models.description: List of known available models on the remote host.

managed_commands_enabled.description: Whether this host supports managed slash commands. Absent this, dispatches always use freeform prompts.

command_surface_path.description: Path on the remote host to the command surface (e.g., C:/Users/you/mythos/.claude/commands/). Only used when managed_commands_enabled is true.

tags.description: Tags for host selection and filtering.
